verdict.rationale: v0's marketing docs mention 'Fine-tune every detail with visual controls and live preview' (v0-docs-7), hinting at some direct-manipulation editing, but there is no concrete documentation or demonstration of selecting an element and editing its text/style/layout without a prompt round-trip. All other evidence describes v0 as fundamentally a chat/prompt-driven code generation tool, and community feedback (v0-comm-4) suggests iteration happens via prompting rather than direct canvas editing. Missing for 10: detailed docs or demos of a click-to-select inspector/editor, evidence of style/layout editing UI, and independent confirmation that changes bypass the AI prompt loop.
